- `bbcode` is expected to be in lowercase which is proper for the styleguide.

So, okay... I won't document it here but I'll keep it in mind.

The problem is less about any specific term being used, and more so about... providing a general overview of what it entails, so to speak. Even if inaccurate, the original description does this ("variable, signal, or enum") and I'd like to replicate that.

So I was trying to ask what would've been most ideal for doing this. Something like:
> When set to [b]Warn[/b] or [b]Error[/b], produces a warning or an error respectively when a declared symbol (any variable, method, signal, constant, etc.) would have the same name as a built-in function or global class name, thus shadowing it.
